title: Save status notification and external change detection (F-006)
description: Implement 2-tier save feedback: (1) Inline micro-feedback in FeaturesSettings.tsx after successful save - show confirmation message that differs based on sync toggle state (toggle OFF: '已保存到插件存储', toggle ON: '已保存到插件存储，并同步 N 项变更到 settings.json'). (2) External change detection via ConfigurationMonitor - when webview is open and settings.json changes externally, post message to webview to show refresh banner.

criteria: FeaturesSettings.tsx has 1 saveStatus state for inline notification
After save response with syncResult: show '已保存到插件存储' when toggle OFF or syncResult.synced === 0
After save response with syncResult: show '已保存到插件存储，并同步 N 项变更到 settings.json' when toggle ON and synced > 0
ConfigurationMonitor detects external feature config changes and posts ExternalConfigChanged to webview
FeaturesSettings.tsx handles ExternalConfigChanged message and shows refresh banner
Notification uses inline webview display, NOT vscode.window.showInformationMessage
convergence.definition_of_done: Save feedback shows in webview with sync-aware messaging, external changes trigger refresh banner

artifacts.usage: Two-tier feedback pattern and external change detection design

rationale.why: Users need confirmation that settings were persisted and awareness of sync behavior
rationale.approach: Inline webview notifications instead of disruptive vscode popups

risks.risk: Frequent external changes causing notification fatigue
risks.mitigation: Debounce notifications (max once per 5 seconds) per spec recommendation
